column1: # Classes of the open MUST rows, read by scripts/open-must.py, which writes OPEN-MUST.md.
# One line per row: ID, class, size, owner, what would close it (tab-separated). Classes:
#   A  RFC behaviour implemented and tested, a named setting, not the default because a named
#      browser cell or deployed peer cannot interoperate, or a named repository test measured
#   B  implemented, lacking a test that fails without it
#   C  partly implemented (the close column says what is missing)
#   E  cannot be met or observed inside this engine for the stated reason
#   F  the note is stale: the behaviour is already tested on this tree
# Owner "(running)" marks a row another agent's branch owns now; it is listed, not worked.
# A row closed since it was classified (tested / n/a) is reported by --check as stale.
